propositions: UNDECLARED file_impact causes over-broad SHA-drift invalidation (21% false re-reviews) when dependency set is empty; scoping fail-safe to recorded read-set + blast-radius entries reduces false positives while preserving fail-closed behavior.
Signed manifest records normalized read-set (deduplicated, repo-relative, existence-filtered paths from read_file fetches only) and membership digest for globs; modified read-set fails verification.

ADR-0002 dependency-hash check applies to read-set ∪ blast-radius only when all four preconditions hold: empty pre-existing dependency set, no container poison, UNDECLARED scope, and recorded read-set.
currency-basis field (file_impact | read-set | fail-safe) is recorded at signing and reported by plan_review_status; unverifiable read-set or expansion failure falls back to invalidate-on-any-change.
